chapters.title: Welcome to JavaScript Jam Live and React Miami Collaboration
chapters.description: After resolving initial Twitter Spaces technical glitches, hosts Ishan Anand, Anthony Campolo, and Scott Steinlage welcome listeners to JavaScript Jam Live. They introduce their upcoming month-long collaboration with React Miami, explaining how future sessions will feature conference speakers while encouraging web developers of all skill levels to participate in the open-mic format.

chapters.title: Meet the React Miami Media Partners and Organizers
chapters.description: The hosts bring up guest speakers Dev Agrawal, Dan, and React Miami organizer Michelle to introduce themselves. Despite minor microphone issues, Michelle expresses her excitement about giving the media partners creative freedom for the upcoming conference, setting the stage for the special interactive events planned for the community.

chapters.title: Introducing the Miami Jam Interactive Game Show
chapters.description: Dev Agrawal outlines the concept for Miami Jam, an upcoming game show designed to replace traditional speaker panels. Concluding at 00:08:42, the discussion covers how the event will use JavaScript and React trivia to spark deeper conversations about speaker topics while incorporating live audience participation and point-scoring.
